parsed.english: For n ≥ 32, any valid rational formula (every division has a nonzero denominator) over ℂ that computes the permanent of the generic n×n matrix of indeterminates, viewed in the fraction field, has at least n^4/(192·log₂ n) variable leaves.
parsed.why_clearer: It inlines the bespoke `permanentPolynomial` as the Mathlib permanent of the generic matrix `Matrix.mvPolynomialX`, and it writes the hypotheses as an explicit chain of implications.
